parameters.name: AclUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the access control policy.

To delete an access control policy, you must specify the UUID of the policy. You can call the [DescribeControlPolicy](~~138866~~) operation to query the UUID.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the traffic to which the access control policy applies.

Valid values:

*   **in**: inbound.
*   **out**: outbound.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response.

Valid values:

*   **zh** (default)
*   **en**

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the traffic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw delete-control-policy --source-ip 192.0.XX.XX --lang zh --acl-uuid 00281255-d220-4db1-8f4f-c4df221ad84c --direction in --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DeleteControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '192.0.XX.XX' --Lang zh --AclUuid '00281255-d220-4db1-8f4f-c4df221ad84c' --Direction in
